subject: Day 57: comfort post-vaccine fussiness
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day one of the post-vaccine recovery window. Expect a fussier, sleepier baby for 24 to 48 hours; the job today is comfort, hydration, and weight-based fever management.

Action items
- Expect mild fever, fussiness, and extra sleep for 24 to 48 hours; escalate for fever over 102 to 104F rectal or inconsolable crying past three hours. AAP immunization policy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Dose acetaminophen weight-based per the pediatrician only if he is uncomfortable; treat the fever after the fact, not on a schedule. AAP immunization policy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Keep offering feeds on demand from yesterday's pre-filled supply, since fussiness can suppress intake for a day.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Low-grade fever at or below 101F rectal, a tender injection site, more sleep than usual, and mild diarrhea from the rotavirus dose.
- [monitor] Fever 102 to 104F rectal lasting beyond 48 hours, or hard injection-site swelling of 2 to 4 inches.
- [call within 24h] Inconsolable crying past three hours, a hypotonic-hyporesponsive episode, or injection-site swelling that crosses a joint.
- [call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher with lethargy, blue lips, labored breathing, or a seizure; for blue lips or trouble breathing call 911 now!

Enrichment opportunities
- Soothe with the same live lullaby you use nightly; a familiar melody aids regulation on a hard day, and the repetition is what helps. Infant music perception (PubMed): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22490184/
- Lean on the lights-out song to ease an extra-sleepy evening into rest, keeping the bedtime sequence identical to other nights. HealthyChildren sleep routine: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Getting-Your-Baby-to-Sleep.aspx
- Offer skin-to-skin chest time rather than structured floor activity today; it supports comfort and lets you skip tummy time without consequence.

Upcoming
- Day 57-72: you are inside the post-vaccine window now; symptoms should fade within 48 hours.
- Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months; begin a consistent sleep-wake routine.
- Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Looks at a toy for several seconds
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Sustained visual attention — precedes reaching.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/looks-at-toy-several-seconds/complete

- Coos or makes sounds beyond crying
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Vowel sounds like ooh, ahh. Pre-language vocalization. Distinct from fussing or hiccup sounds.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/coos-makes-sounds/complete

- Holds head up while on tummy
  AAP window: day 35-60
  What to look for: Sustained head lift of several seconds, not just a brief bob. Forearms may or may not be supporting yet.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/holds-head-up-tummy/complete

- Hands relax open most of the time
  AAP window: day 35-90
  What to look for: Newborn fists relax as the palmar grasp reflex fades. Predictor of voluntary grasp coming.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/hands-open-mostly/complete

- First social smile (responding to a face, not gas)
  AAP window: day 28-60
  What to look for: Smile in response to someone smiling or talking to them, not a reflexive gas smile. Hallmark social milestone.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/first-social-smile/complete
